name: Decent
long_description: Decent is an AI-native health insurance brokerage. We quote every available option, like Kayak for health plans, and then monitor and act on claims data continuously to make your plan better and cheaper year-round.
one_liner: Continuous optimization for employer health plans.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Decent. Previously founded Decent, Inc., a venture-backed health plan administrator (acquired by Nice Healthcare). EIR at Foundation Capital. Growth Product Lead at Gusto. PM on Kindle at Amazon. Founded LikeBright/Reveal (acquired by Napster). Stanford BA, Harvard MBA.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Decent. Previously Director of Software Engineering at Meta, where he led Metamate (Meta's internal AI assistant and Agent Platform) and built deep learning computer vision systems shipping in Oculus. Before Meta, engineering manager at Amazon for 5 years and engineer at Microsoft. BS Applied Mathematics from UCLA.
